name: PUEBLO 392

specs.notes: 475 hp and 637 N m (470 lb-ft) from the 6.4 naturally aspirated HEMI, 0-60 mph in 4.4 s (Dodge), 1/4 mile 12.9 s, 2,439 kg (5,378 lb) curb, 3,043 mm wheelbase; ~158 mph top (a 3.70 axle). AWD with an open front axle; 35 % front used.

garage.blurb: A three-row family hauler with a 6.4-litre V8 and no turbos. Long, heavy and calm at speed: it pulls hard and steady and settles like a big car should.

interior.notes: The model's dark cabin kept as it is (no textures in the package); steering wheel cut out to turn.

limitations: The package has no texture images: its materials are plain colours.
